bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/profile-live-20261114"
TARGET="6445896df387d290b6a0517d8cdb72c0471db4c7"
test -d "$WT"
test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/feat/profile-recruitment-album-20261114
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
git -C "$WT" checkout --detach "$TARGET" >/dev/null
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
test -r "$ROOT/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt"
test -w "$HOME/.local/share/tgtumbler/profile-pr"
docker compose --project-directory "$ROOT/deploy" -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy config -q
command -v gh >/dev/null
for attempt in $(seq 1 18); do
 RUN_ID="$(gh run list -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --workflow tgtumbler-gaybbs-package.yml --branch feat/profile-recruitment-album-20261114 --limit 45 --json databaseId,headSha,conclusion --jq '.[] | select(.headSha == "6445896df387d290b6a0517d8cdb72c0471db4c7" and .conclusion == "success") | .databaseId' | head -n 1)"
 if test -n "$RUN_ID"; then break; fi
 sleep 5
done
test -n "$RUN_ID" || { echo 'PROFILE_CI_BUNDLE_NOT_READY' >&2; exit 33; }
TEMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TEMP"' EXIT
gh run download "$RUN_ID" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$TEMP"
test -s "$TEMP/gaybbs.mjs"
cat > "$TEMP/Dockerfile" <<'DOCKER'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
COPY --chown=node:node gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
DOCKER
ORIG="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
docker build --pull=false --network none -f "$TEMP/Dockerfile" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-candidate "$TEMP" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-candidate --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
test "$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$ORIG"
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-profile-20261114-b741
changed=0
rollback(){
 if test "$changed" = 1; then
  docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-profile-20261114-b741 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || true
  docker compose --project-directory "$ROOT/deploy" -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || true
 fi
}
trap 'rollback; rm -rf "$TEMP"' EXIT
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-candidate gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
changed=1
docker compose --project-directory "$ROOT/deploy" -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 10
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.RestartCount}}')" = 0
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-candidate --format '{{.Id}}')"
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -qx 'PROFILE_PR_STORAGE_DIR=/app/profile-pr'
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Destination}}{{end}}' | grep -qx '/app/profile-pr'
PG="$(docker compose --project-directory "$ROOT/deploy" -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy ps -q postgres)"
test -n "$PG"
docker exec "$PG" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='profiles' AND column_name='profile_context';" | grep -qx 1
changed=0
trap 'rm -rf "$TEMP"' EXIT
printf 'PROFILE_PRODUCTION_IMAGE=PASS\nPROFILE_MEDIA_STORAGE_MOUNT=PASS\nPROFILE_DB_MIGRATION=PASS\nPROFILE_ARTIFACT_RUN=%s\n' "$RUN_ID"
